Omega Speedmaster Moonwatch Professional 310.30.42.50.01.001: what a tachymeter bezel actually does.

The scale turns a stopwatch time over a known distance into average speed. Start at one marker, stop at the next, then read the scale.

USD 7,800 new, per The 1916 Company (22 Nov 2026). Retailer prices vary, so check before you buy.
